CD4+ Tfh.description: A CD4+ T helper subtype specialized in providing help to B cells within germinal centers, marked by CXCR5 and PD-1.

NK cell.description: An innate lymphoid cell that kills infected or malignant cells without prior sensitization, characterized by cytotoxic granules and NK receptors.
